verdict.rationale: MailerLite's own developer docs state that AI assistants can connect to MailerLite through the Model Context Protocol. The homepage adds that users can perform actions and analyze data via natural-language prompts in Claude, which indicates a first-party MCP integration. missing for 10: documented server endpoint/setup steps, list of exposed tools and auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect AI assistants to MailerLite using Model Context Protocol for seamless integration.
Perform actions in MailerLite and analyze data with natural language prompts in Claude.
